statement: The representation-defined higher-rank Euler-system route does not reproduce R8's target-rank circularity, but it also does not supply the missing BSD bridge: over Q the elliptic-curve Tate module has basic rank one, while the rank-two Heegner realization occurs after base change to K and its construction/derivative/leading-term use requires main-conjecture, positive algebraic-rank, Sha-finiteness and regulator premises not derived from complex analytic rank two over Q.
